title: Manipulated / edited audio
summary: A benign delivery message whose audio was edited: two recordings with different background noise are joined at about 00:10.
voice_note: The clip was built for this demo by joining two text-to-speech segments with different noise floors. The manipulation indicator is scenario-injected (simulated). The experimental noise-floor check also analyses the clip for real and is shown separately as experimental.

expected.note: Manipulation is shown on its own. No scam content, so no fraud verdict and no ping.
